meta.baseline: none — first report, no prior upgrade_research files

findings.name: FLUX.2 Klein NVFP4 quantisation
findings.replacement: FLUX.2 Klein NVFP4 + FP8 official ComfyUI support
findings.action: Download klein_4b_nvfp4.safetensors via ComfyUI model manager; update build_klein_* preset checkpoint path. No workflow restructuring needed.
findings.notes: NVFP4: 2.7× speedup, 55% VRAM reduction vs BF16 on Blackwell GPUs. Klein 9B FP8 ~18 GB — needs offload. Ships with ComfyUI v0.27.0.

findings.name: SAM 3.1 Object Multiplex
findings.action: Download SAM 3.1 checkpoint from Meta AI / HF; replace SAM3 checkpoint path in server config. Drop-in; no API changes.
findings.notes: 32 FPS (from 16 FPS). 4 GB VRAM FP16 (from 8 GB). Joint multi-object tracking in single forward pass. Outside strict window but first audit — checkpoint version must be verified on server.

findings.name: HyperSwap 256 ONNX
findings.action: Download hyperswap_256_1c.onnx from facefusion/models-3.3.0 on HF. Change swap_model param in build_faceswap/build_video_reactor callers. Verify ComfyUI-ReActor version >= 0.6.2.
findings.notes: 2× resolution vs inswapper_128. FaceFusion 3.7.0 (June 30, in window) validated weights. ReActor v0.6.2 (April 25 2026) added HyperSwap node support. VRAM neutral (ONNX inference).

findings.name: Boogu-Image-0.1-Edit-Turbo
findings.action: Install boogu-project/ComfyUI-Boogu node pack or use ComfyUI v0.26.0+ native nodes. Add new build_boogu_edit builder. CPU offload text encoder to fit 16 GB.
findings.notes: 10B unified image-gen + instruction-driven edit. 4-step distilled. FP8 ~10 GB + ~10.5 GB TE (sequential offload). No dedicated inpaint mode yet. Potential second instruction-edit engine alongside build_qwen_edit.

findings.name: ComfyUI v0.27.0
findings.action: Upgrade ComfyUI on server. No breaking changes expected. Enables NVFP4 Klein (W27-001) and int8 LoRA improvements.
findings.notes: New features: int8 convrot for RTX Turing+, int8 LoRA apply optimised, memory leak fixes, new nodes: Seed, ConditioningMultiply, Bounding Box Canvas. NVIDIA NVFP4 integration ships with this version.

findings.name: RTX VSR node (comfyui-deno-custom-nodes v0.7.67)
findings.action: Install comfyui-deno-custom-nodes v0.7.67. Requires nvidia-vfx Python package on server. Chain RTX VSR after existing upscale nodes.
findings.notes: Hardware-accelerated 2–4× VSR on Blackwell Tensor Cores via NVIDIA nvvfx library. Also includes LTX 2.3 and WAN 2.2 helper nodes. Low VRAM overhead — operates on decoded frames.

findings.name: LTX-Video ICLoRA adapters
findings.action: Add inject_ltx_iclora() composite to build_ltx_video, analogous to existing inject_controlnet(). Three adapter weights available on HF.
findings.notes: Pose / depth / canny ControlNet-style LoRAs for LTX 13B. Weights on HF since Jul 2025. Requires new injection path in builder — additive change.

findings.name: SeedVR2 V2.5 BlockSwap
findings.action: Install numz/ComfyUI-SeedVR2_VideoUpscaler wrapper. Add block_swap argument to build_seedv2r / build_seedvr2_video_upscale if not already present.
findings.notes: CPU block-offloading; 12–14 GB peak VRAM. Community ComfyUI wrapper. First audit — verify builders expose block-swap param.

findings.name: Krea-2-RAW / Krea-2-Turbo
findings.licence: Krea research licence (NOT Apache-2.0, commercial restrictions)
findings.action: Evaluate Krea research licence for commercial use before adding. 12.9B FP8 at 12 GiB fits 16 GB. If licence acceptable, add build_krea2_txt2img.
findings.notes: 12.9B dense DiT. Qwen3-VL encoder. 8-step Turbo at ~2 s/image on RTX 5060 Ti. Rivals FLUX.1 on prompt adherence. Released 5 days before window — near-miss.

findings.name: SAM2Matting
findings.action: Watch for code/weights release. Wire into build_sam3_mask/extract when ComfyUI node lands. Expected Q3 2026.
findings.notes: Paper June 25 2026 (2 days before window). No weights or ComfyUI nodes yet. Region-proposal bridge + matting head; quality improvement on hair/fur edges vs binary SAM masks.

findings.name: HunyuanVideo 1.5
findings.action: Probe Kijai wrapper /object_info for model_version=1.5 parameter. If supported, update build_hunyuan_video default checkpoint. 1,011 likes / 2.4K downloads on HF.
findings.notes: 1,011 likes / 2.4K downloads. SSTA architecture + built-in video super-resolution. Lighter than original 13B. Nov 2025 release, last-modified Dec 2025.

findings.name: Sapiens2 (Meta AI)
findings.action: Monitor for ComfyUI-Sapiens2 node pack. 0.4B fits 16 GB. Wire into build_normal_map when node available. Q3 2026.
findings.notes: ICLR 2026. Native 1K resolution; 8.63° mean angular error at 0.4B. Covers depth, pose, albedo in addition to normals. No confirmed ComfyUI node pack yet.

findings.name: TRELLIS 2 (microsoft/TRELLIS.2-4B)

findings.action: Monitor for ComfyUI node pack. 12–16 GB VRAM — marginal on 16 GB. No ComfyUI node confirmed yet. Q3 2026.
findings.notes: 4B param; O-Voxel sparse voxel; PBR materials; 1536³ resolution. Dec 16 2025 paper. Competitive with Hunyuan3D on quality; PBR is differentiator.

findings.notes: Higher resolution than CodeFormer 512 px. Usable now — one-param change. April 25 2026 ReActor release.
